question: Add the term bittorrent to the interface vocabulary of scripts/dossier/schema.json?
why: A public data file over BitTorrent (Academic Torrents) is a route in data-apis/crossref and data-apis/stack-exchange-api, and storage/academic-torrents and storage/internet-archive-bittorrents are reached through a torrent client. Each record uses rest, s3 or rclone, the nearest term, and names the torrent in its text. A value that fits no term extends the vocabulary, so a rules session adds bittorrent and names these records.
